verdict.rationale: Asaas documents an API to list and retrieve payments and check their status, plus Webhooks, so an agent could monitor payments. Cards can be processed after creation, which loosely supports retries. Automatic WhatsApp/email/SMS/voice notifications before and after the due date, and Serasa negativação, cover dunning outreach. missing for 10: documented failed-payment or overdue webhook event types, an explicit payment retry API or retry logic, evidence that dunning notifications can be configured or triggered via API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor failed payments via API and webhooks and drive retries and dunning outreach
